tasks.short: Conduct community programmes about drugs, violence and related topics

steps.what: Select age-appropriate community programme topics and authorised guidance
Assemble and check materials concerning drugs and violence
Conduct community programs for all ages and respond to questions

tasks.design: Reuse authorised public-information sections in {DOCS} after the officer selects topics for the audience. The officer checks the final pack and retains all community discussion; sensitive personal disclosures follow existing support and safeguarding routes.
tasks.previous_blocker: Standard public-information material is repeatedly assembled for similar sessions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document reuse reduces layout and copying without generating advice or replacing a community relationship.
tasks.still_hard: Making difficult topics appropriate to the audience and responding safely to personal concerns.
tasks.human_edge: The officer can notice distress, build trust and direct a person to the right support.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less preparation repetition; no change to public interaction or editorial responsibility.

reach.task: Clarify a support route for a participant's non-enforcement concern

evidence.claim: Native reusable sections can reduce copying in community-programme materials after content selection; the proposed saving is unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is preparation and delivery, not individual case investigation or automated advice.
Officer in s1 records topic, audience age range, objectives, selected guidance identifiers and versions, format and support routes. Full 20 hours retain discussion, selection and capture.

Retained 9 hours of s2 include entering session details and checking meaning, currency, age suitability and referral wording. Missing content is handled manually; no unproduced audience-risk profile is assumed.
S3 uses the checked pack and stays within authorised guidance; new factual material requires rechecking. Unscripted personal concerns are referred rather than answered by a model.
Test native reuse before custom code; existing templates earn no saving.
unknowns: Current preparation effort and editorial authority
Approved age-specific materials and support routes
research_questions: Can reusable materials reduce assembly while preserving age suitability and the quality of audience discussion?

already_counted.description: Programme selection and exact source-version capture
Current details, editorial checks and exceptions

incremental.description: Maintain reusable material references and support-route details

approvals.approved_version: Exact community-pack version with audience, wording, source versions and support routes; edits void approval and require another s2 check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 scenario: B=100 and R=20+9+65=94 give gross 6, less 1 upkeep yields net 5. High requires repeated material assembly; low assumes just 1 hour removed in bespoke sessions, consumed by upkeep. Topic judgement and public delivery retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Serve court-ordered documents within local authority

steps.what: Check court orders, intended recipient and authorised service requirements
Serve statements of claims, subpoenas, summonses and other court orders
Record, check and save the actual court-document service outcome

tasks.design: Configure reuse of checked document particulars in the authorised service-record {OTHER}. The officer still checks legal requirements, performs service and records the actual outcome; software never infers that service succeeded from an address or attempted visit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Document particulars may be retyped into a separate outcome record after service.
tasks.enabler_now: Native field reuse can reduce repeated particulars while preserving current outcome entry and checking.
tasks.still_hard: Establishing the correct recipient and whether the actual event satisfies local service requirements.
tasks.human_edge: The officer can recognise uncertainty, avoid a false success entry and seek legal or supervisory clarification.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated record entry; no change to service law or the officer's powers.

reach.task: Clarify a local court-document service requirement
reach.learn: Jurisdictional scope and evidence of service

evidence.claim: Native records can reuse checked particulars while requiring fresh outcome entry; the proposed service-record saving is an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: The US list maps only to court documents that this local role may serve; some service belongs to other authorised professions. Inapplicability creates no saving.
Boundary is checking, serving and internal outcome recording, not court issuance, legal validity decisions by a court or external filing.

Officer in s1 checks and captures document reference, issuing authority, exact recipient particulars, service address as provided, document version and applicable instruction. Full 20 hours include verification and capture; no structured address is assumed to arrive without checking.

In retained s3 time officer enters actual attempt time, location, recipient verification performed, method, observed result and uncertainty or failure reason, then checks the whole record before save. Missing source fields or unverified outcomes require manual entry and clarification.
Test native record reuse before custom code. Existing prefill earns no new saving; no automatic success flag or electronic legal service is introduced.
unknowns: Current duplicate entry and record-system features
research_questions: Which particulars can be reused without implying a service outcome, and can the form preserve uncertain or failed attempts?

already_counted.description: Document and recipient verification with source-field capture
Fresh outcome capture, meaning check and confirmation

incremental.description: Maintain field mappings and service-record exception handling

approvals.approved_version: Exact service record with document version, recipient particulars, actual attempt, method, outcome and uncertainty; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 scenario: B=100 and R=20+65+9=94 give gross 6, less 1 upkeep yields net 5. High requires repeated particulars in the 15-hour recording step. Low assumes only 1 hour removed in an already linked system, consumed by upkeep. Legal checks and physical service retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce repeated material and service-record assembly while keeping public engagement and legal service decisions with the officer.
reach: Clarify support routes with community workers and local service requirements with authorised court-service roles
role.ambitious_version: An officer who can provide clear community information and traceable service records without extending automated advice or legal authority.
